18596/// `inject_fstat` and `add_fd` against a scripted guest whose "address space"
18597/// is this test process, so every injected syscall runs for real on host
18598/// memory and a real descriptor. Regression coverage for
18599/// <https://github.com/rrnewton/hermit/issues/3328>; the traced end-to-end case
18600/// is `tests_misc::tight_stack_openat`.
18601#[cfg(test)]
18602mod inject_fstat_scratch {
18603    use std::os::fd::IntoRawFd;
18604    use std::os::fd::RawFd;
18605    use std::os::unix::ffi::OsStrExt;
18606    use std::os::unix::ffi::OsStringExt;
18607    use std::os::unix::fs::MetadataExt;
18608    use std::sync::Arc;
18609    use std::sync::atomic::AtomicBool;
18610    use std::sync::atomic::Ordering;
18611
18612    use reverie::GlobalRPC;
18613    use reverie::GlobalTool;
18614    use reverie::Pid;
18615    use reverie::Tool;
18616    use reverie::syscalls::LocalMemory;
18617    use reverie::syscalls::ProtFlags;
18618
18619    use super::*;
18620    use crate::Config;
18621    use crate::GlobalState;
18622    use crate::ThreadState;
18623    use crate::types::DetPid;
18624
18625    /// Room for one `libc::stat`, 8-byte aligned like a real stack slot.
18626    const ARENA_WORDS: usize = 32;
18627
18628    /// A guest stack scratch that is either writable or faults on commit,
18629    /// like the ptrace scratch below an `rsp` with no writable memory under
18630    /// it. The writable arena belongs to the guest and outlives every guard,
18631    /// so an early guard drop is reported by `guard_live` rather than by a
18632    /// write into freed memory.
18633    struct ScriptedStack {
18634        writable: bool,
18635        /// Match ptrace reserve/commit's actual zero write in the new controls.
18636        zero_on_commit: bool,
18637        arena: usize,
18638        capacity: usize,
18639        guard_live: Arc<AtomicBool>,
18640        /// A failing commit first overwrites the scratch's first word, as a
18641        /// commit that faults part way does.
18642        partial: bool,
18643        /// A page that a failing commit makes read-only after its partial
18644        /// write, so the borrower cannot put the bytes back.
18645        protect_on_failure: Option<usize>,
18646    }
18647
18648    struct ScriptedStackGuard {
18649        guard_live: Arc<AtomicBool>,
18650    }
18651
18652    impl Drop for ScriptedStackGuard {
18653        fn drop(&mut self) {
18654            self.guard_live.store(false, Ordering::SeqCst);
18655        }
18656    }
18657
18658    impl reverie::Stack for ScriptedStack {
18659        type StackGuard = ScriptedStackGuard;
18660
18661        fn size(&self) -> usize {
18662            panic!("inject_fstat must not query the scratch size")
18663        }
18664        fn capacity(&self) -> usize {
18665            panic!("inject_fstat must not query the scratch capacity")
18666        }
18667        fn push<'stack, T>(&mut self, value: T) -> Addr<'stack, T> {
18668            assert!(std::mem::size_of::<T>() <= self.capacity);
18669            assert!(std::mem::align_of::<T>() <= std::mem::align_of::<u64>());
18670            // SAFETY: this mock's arena is aligned and large enough for the
18671            // one pathname the readlink handler stages before its injection.
18672            unsafe { (self.arena as *mut T).write(value) };
18673            Addr::from_raw(self.arena).unwrap()
18674        }
18675        fn reserve<'stack, T>(&mut self) -> AddrMut<'stack, T> {
18676            assert!(std::mem::size_of::<T>() <= self.capacity);
18677            AddrMut::from_raw(self.arena).unwrap()
18678        }
18679        fn commit(self) -> Result<Self::StackGuard, Errno> {
18680            if !self.writable {
18681                if self.partial {
18682                    // SAFETY: the arena (or scratch page) is this guest's,
18683                    // writable until protected below.
18684                    unsafe { (self.arena as *mut u64).write(0) };
18685                }
18686                if let Some(page) = self.protect_on_failure {
18687                    // SAFETY: the page is the test's own mapping.
18688                    assert_eq!(
18689                        unsafe { libc::mprotect(page as *mut _, 4096, libc::PROT_READ) },
18690                        0
18691                    );
18692                }
18693                return Err(Errno::EFAULT);
18694            }
18695            if self.zero_on_commit {
18696                // SAFETY: reserve checked the arena capacity and the owned
18697                // arena/page is writable for the duration of this stack.
18698                unsafe {
18699                    std::ptr::write_bytes(
18700                        self.arena as *mut u8,
18701                        0,
18702                        std::mem::size_of::<libc::stat>(),
18703                    )
18704                };
18705            }
18706            self.guard_live.store(true, Ordering::SeqCst);
18707            Ok(ScriptedStackGuard {
18708                guard_live: self.guard_live,
18709            })
18710        }
18711    }
18712
18713    struct ScriptedGuest {
18714        config: Config,
18715        thread: ThreadState<()>,
18716        stack_writable: bool,
18717        zero_on_commit: bool,
18718        mmap_fails: bool,
18719        arena: Box<[u64; ARENA_WORDS]>,
18720        guard_live: Arc<AtomicBool>,
18721        injected: Vec<Sysno>,
18722        /// Whether a stack guard was live when each fstat was injected.
18723        fstat_guard_live: Vec<bool>,
18724        /// Buffer address of each injected fstat.
18725        fstat_buffers: Vec<usize>,
18726        /// (address, length) of each page the guest mapped.
18727        mapped: Vec<(usize, usize)>,
18728        /// (address, length) of each successful munmap.
18729        unmapped: Vec<(usize, usize)>,
18730        /// Descriptors closed through injection.
18731        closed: Vec<RawFd>,
18732        runtime_fd: Option<RawFd>,
18733        backend_ids: Option<(Pid, Pid)>,
18734        /// Explicit guest-to-kernel process/thread mapping for proc translation.
18735        procfs_ids: Option<[(i32, i32); 2]>,
18736        rsp: Option<usize>,
18737        /// Paths actually handed to the kernel for parent authentication.
18738        statat_paths: Vec<Vec<u8>>,
18739        directory_batches: std::collections::VecDeque<Result<Vec<u8>, Errno>>,
18740        /// Scripted refusals of injected opens, in order; an open with none
18741        /// left opens a real file.
18742        open_errors: std::collections::VecDeque<Errno>,
18743        /// The paths of injected opens, as the guest's memory held them.
18744        opened_paths: Vec<Vec<u8>>,
18745        /// The real descriptors injected opens returned.
18746        opened_fds: Vec<RawFd>,
18747        /// Scripted errors of injected closes, in order, before any real
18748        /// close.
18749        close_errors: std::collections::VecDeque<Errno>,
18750        /// Every injected close's descriptor, a scripted failure included.
18751        close_attempts: Vec<RawFd>,
18752        /// Scripted errors of injected fstats, in order, before any real
18753        /// fstat.
18754        fstat_errors: std::collections::VecDeque<Errno>,
18755        /// The effective set an injected capget reports (the permitted set is
18756        /// every capability).
18757        capget_effective: u64,
18758        /// A page of its own for the stack scratch, in place of the arena.
18759        scratch_page: Option<usize>,
18760        /// A failing commit's partial write, and whether it then makes the
18761        /// scratch page read-only.
18762        commit_partial: bool,
18763        protect_page_on_commit_failure: bool,
18764        /// The injected syscall at which the scratch page becomes read-only,
18765        /// so that putting its bytes back fails.
18766        protect_page_on: Option<Sysno>,
18767        private_memory: Option<reverie::RuntimePrivateMemorySnapshot>,
18768        private_retired: bool,
18769        private_validations: std::sync::atomic::AtomicUsize,
18770        maps_reads: std::collections::VecDeque<Vec<u8>>,
18771        /// A successful Binder read publishes this many command bytes.
18772        binder_read_consumed: Option<u64>,
18773    }
18774
18775    impl ScriptedGuest {
18776        fn new(stack_writable: bool, mmap_fails: bool) -> (Detcore, Self) {
18777            let config = Config {
18778                virtualize_metadata: true,
18779                ..Config::default()
18780            };
18781            let pid = DetPid::from_raw(1);
18782            let mut thread = ThreadState::new(pid, &config, ());
18783            thread.detpid = Some(pid);
18784            let tool = <Detcore as Tool>::new(Pid::from_raw(1), &config);
18785            let guest = Self {
18786                config,
18787                thread,
18788                stack_writable,
18789                zero_on_commit: false,
18790                mmap_fails,
18791                arena: Box::new([u64::MAX; ARENA_WORDS]),
18792                guard_live: Arc::new(AtomicBool::new(false)),
18793                injected: Vec::new(),
18794                fstat_guard_live: Vec::new(),
18795                fstat_buffers: Vec::new(),
18796                mapped: Vec::new(),
18797                unmapped: Vec::new(),
18798                closed: Vec::new(),
18799                runtime_fd: None,
18800                backend_ids: None,
18801                procfs_ids: None,
18802                rsp: None,
18803                statat_paths: Vec::new(),
18804                directory_batches: Default::default(),
18805                open_errors: Default::default(),
18806                opened_paths: Vec::new(),
18807                opened_fds: Vec::new(),
18808                close_errors: Default::default(),
18809                close_attempts: Vec::new(),
18810                fstat_errors: Default::default(),
18811                capget_effective: (1 << 41) - 1,
18812                scratch_page: None,
18813                commit_partial: false,
18814                protect_page_on_commit_failure: false,
18815                protect_page_on: None,
18816                private_memory: None,
18817                private_retired: false,
18818                private_validations: std::sync::atomic::AtomicUsize::new(0),
18819                maps_reads: Default::default(),
18820                binder_read_consumed: None,
18821            };
18822            (tool, guest)
18823        }
18824
18825        /// A guest whose stack scratch is a page of its own, holding a
18826        /// pattern, and whose failure policy returns EOPNOTSUPP rather than
18827        /// stopping (as with --allow-unsupported-syscalls).
18828        fn with_scratch_page(stack_writable: bool) -> (Detcore, Self) {
18829            let (tool, mut guest) = Self::new(stack_writable, false);
18830            guest.config.panic_on_unsupported_syscalls = false;
18831            // SAFETY: a fresh private anonymous page, unmapped by the test.
18832            let page = unsafe {
18833                libc::mmap(
18834                    std::ptr::null_mut(),
18835                    4096,
18836                    libc::PROT_READ | libc::PROT_WRITE,
18837                    libc::MAP_PRIVATE | libc::MAP_ANONYMOUS,
18838                    -1,
18839                    0,
18840                )
18841            };
18842            assert_ne!(page, libc::MAP_FAILED);
18843            // SAFETY: the page is 4096 writable bytes.
18844            unsafe { std::ptr::write_bytes(page as *mut u8, 0xa5, 4096) };
18845            guest.scratch_page = Some(page as usize);
18846            (tool, guest)
18847        }
18848
18849        /// The scratch page's bytes, and the page unmapped.
18850        fn take_scratch_page(&mut self) -> Vec<u8> {
18851            let page = self.scratch_page.take().unwrap();
18852            // SAFETY: the page is the test's mapping, readable throughout.
18853            let bytes = unsafe { std::slice::from_raw_parts(page as *const u8, 4096) }.to_vec();
18854            assert_eq!(unsafe { libc::munmap(page as *mut _, 4096) }, 0);
18855            bytes
18856        }
18857    }

18859    #[reverie::tool]
18860    impl GlobalRPC<GlobalState> for ScriptedGuest {
18861        async fn send_rpc(
18862            &self,
18863            message: <GlobalState as GlobalTool>::Request,
18864        ) -> <GlobalState as GlobalTool>::Response {
18865            if let GlobalRequest::ProcfsIds(to_kernel, ids) = &message.2
18866                && let Some(mapping) = self.procfs_ids
18867            {
18868                let resolved = ids
18869                    .iter()
18870                    .map(|id| {
18871                        mapping.iter().find_map(|&(guest, kernel)| {
18872                            let (from, to) = if *to_kernel {
18873                                (guest, kernel)
18874                            } else {
18875                                (kernel, guest)
18876                            };
18877                            (*id == from).then_some(to)
18878                        })
18879                    })
18880                    .collect();
18881                return (None, GlobalResponse::ProcfsIds(resolved));
18882            }
18883            panic!("fd registration must not send an RPC: {:?}", message.2)
18884        }
18885        fn config(&self) -> &Config {
18886            &self.config
18887        }
18888    }

18890    #[reverie::tool]
18891    impl Guest<Detcore> for ScriptedGuest {
18892        type Memory = LocalMemory;
18893        type Stack = ScriptedStack;
18894
18895        fn tid(&self) -> Pid {
18896            self.backend_ids.map_or(Pid::from_raw(1), |(_, tid)| tid)
18897        }
18898        fn pid(&self) -> Pid {
18899            self.backend_ids.map_or(Pid::from_raw(1), |(pid, _)| pid)
18900        }
18901        fn ppid(&self) -> Option<Pid> {
18902            None
18903        }
18904        fn is_runtime_owned_fd(&self, fd: RawFd) -> bool {
18905            self.runtime_fd == Some(fd)
18906        }
18907        fn runtime_private_memory_regions(&self) -> Option<reverie::RuntimePrivateMemory> {
18908            self.private_memory.clone().map(|facts| {
18909                if self.private_retired {
18910                    reverie::RuntimePrivateMemory::Unavailable
18911                } else {
18912                    reverie::RuntimePrivateMemory::Ready(facts)
18913                }
18914            })
18915        }
18916        fn runtime_private_memory_is_current(
18917            &self,
18918            snapshot: &reverie::RuntimePrivateMemorySnapshot,
18919        ) -> bool {
18920            self.private_validations.fetch_add(1, Ordering::SeqCst);
18921            !self.private_retired && self.private_memory.as_ref() == Some(snapshot)
18922        }
18923        fn memory(&self) -> Self::Memory {
18924            LocalMemory::new()
18925        }
18926        fn thread_state_mut(&mut self) -> &mut ThreadState<()> {
18927            &mut self.thread
18928        }
18929        fn thread_state(&self) -> &ThreadState<()> {
18930            &self.thread
18931        }
18932        async fn regs(&mut self) -> libc::user_regs_struct {
18933            // SAFETY: every register is an integer; only the configured
18934            // stack pointer is needed by these translation controls.
18935            let mut regs: libc::user_regs_struct = unsafe { std::mem::zeroed() };
18936            regs.rsp = self.rsp.expect("fd registration must not read registers") as u64;
18937            regs
18938        }
18939        async fn stack(&mut self) -> Self::Stack {
18940            ScriptedStack {
18941                writable: self.stack_writable,
18942                zero_on_commit: self.zero_on_commit,
18943                arena: self
18944                    .scratch_page
18945                    .unwrap_or(self.arena.as_mut_ptr() as usize),
18946                capacity: if self.scratch_page.is_some() {
18947                    4096
18948                } else {
18949                    ARENA_WORDS * std::mem::size_of::<u64>()
18950                },
18951                guard_live: self.guard_live.clone(),
18952                partial: self.commit_partial,
18953                protect_on_failure: self
18954                    .scratch_page
18955                    .filter(|_| self.protect_page_on_commit_failure),
18956            }
18957        }
18958        async fn daemonize(&mut self) {
18959            panic!("fd registration must not daemonize")
18960        }
18961        async fn inject<S: SyscallInfo>(&mut self, syscall: S) -> Result<i64, Errno> {
18962            let (number, args) = syscall.into_parts();
18963            self.injected.push(number);
18964            if let Some(page) = self
18965                .scratch_page
18966                .filter(|_| self.protect_page_on == Some(number))
18967            {
18968                // SAFETY: the page is the test's own mapping.
18969                assert_eq!(
18970                    unsafe { libc::mprotect(page as *mut _, 4096, libc::PROT_READ) },
18971                    0
18972                );
18973            }
18974            if matches!(number, Sysno::getdents | Sysno::getdents64) {
18975                let bytes = self
18976                    .directory_batches
18977                    .pop_front()
18978                    .expect("scripted getdents")?;
18979                assert!(bytes.len() <= args.arg2);
18980                if !bytes.is_empty() {
18981                    let buffer = AddrMut::from_raw(args.arg1).unwrap();
18982                    self.memory().write_exact(buffer, &bytes)?;
18983                }
18984                return Ok(bytes.len() as i64);
18985            }
18986            if matches!(
18987                number,
18988                Sysno::readlink | Sysno::readlinkat | Sysno::newfstatat
18989            ) {
18990                if number == Sysno::newfstatat {
18991                    let path = PathPtr::from_ptr(args.arg1 as *const libc::c_char).unwrap();
18992                    self.statat_paths
18993                        .push(path.read(&self.memory())?.into_os_string().into_vec());
18994                }
18995                // SAFETY: the tests own every non-null input/output buffer;
18996                // null buffers and invalid descriptors are checked by Linux.
18997                return Errno::result(unsafe {
18998                    libc::syscall(
18999                        number as libc::c_long,
19000                        args.arg0,
19001                        args.arg1,
19002                        args.arg2,
19003                        args.arg3,
19004                        args.arg4,
19005                        args.arg5,
19006                    )
19007                });
19008            }
19009            // SAFETY: each arm runs the syscall Detcore asked for against this
19010            // process, on addresses Detcore obtained from this guest.
19011            let raw = match Syscall::from_raw(number, args) {
19012                Syscall::Ioctl(_) if self.binder_read_consumed.is_some() => {
19013                    assert_eq!(args.arg1 as u64, crate::syscalls::binder::BINDER_WRITE_READ);
19014                    let address = AddrMut::<[u64; 6]>::from_raw(args.arg2).unwrap();
19015                    let mut words: [u64; 6] = self.memory().read_value(address)?;
19016                    words[4] = self.binder_read_consumed.unwrap();
19017                    self.memory().write_value(address, &words)?;
19018                    0
19019                }
19020                Syscall::Lseek(call) if self.private_memory.is_some() => {
19021                    assert_eq!(call.offset(), 0);
19022                    assert_eq!(call.whence(), Whence::SEEK_SET);
19023                    0
19024                }
19025                Syscall::Read(call) if self.private_memory.is_some() => {
19026                    let bytes = self.maps_reads.pop_front().expect("scripted maps drain");
19027                    assert!(bytes.len() <= call.len());
19028                    self.memory().write_exact(call.buf().unwrap(), &bytes)?;
19029                    if bytes.is_empty() {
19030                        // The owner changes generation while the complete
19031                        // drain is in flight, before snapshot publication.
19032                        self.private_retired = true;
19033                    }
19034                    bytes.len() as i64
19035                }
19036                Syscall::Mmap(call) => {
19037                    assert!(call.addr().is_none(), "the kernel must choose the address");
19038                    assert_eq!(call.prot(), ProtFlags::PROT_READ | ProtFlags::PROT_WRITE);
19039                    assert_eq!(
19040                        call.flags(),
19041                        MapFlags::MAP_PRIVATE | MapFlags::MAP_ANONYMOUS
19042                    );
19043                    if self.mmap_fails {
19044                        return Err(Errno::ENOMEM);
19045                    }
19046                    let address = unsafe {
19047                        libc::mmap(
19048                            std::ptr::null_mut(),
19049                            call.len(),
19050                            libc::PROT_READ | libc::PROT_WRITE,
19051                            libc::MAP_PRIVATE | libc::MAP_ANONYMOUS,
19052                            -1,
19053                            0,
19054                        )
19055                    };
19056                    if address == libc::MAP_FAILED {
19057                        -1
19058                    } else {
19059                        self.mapped.push((address as usize, call.len()));
19060                        address as i64
19061                    }
19062                }
19063                Syscall::Fstat(call) => {
19064                    // Model the same owner guard as a real Guest, while
19065                    // keeping readlink a real kernel call. Before the fix,
19066                    // this error arrives after the link wrote its output.
19067                    if self.is_runtime_owned_fd(call.fd()) {
19068                        return Err(Errno::EBADF);
19069                    }
19070                    let buffer = call.stat().expect("fstat without a buffer").0.as_raw();
19071                    self.fstat_buffers.push(buffer);
19072                    self.fstat_guard_live
19073                        .push(self.guard_live.load(Ordering::SeqCst));
19074                    if let Some(errno) = self.fstat_errors.pop_front() {
19075                        return Err(errno);
19076                    }
19077                    i64::from(unsafe { libc::fstat(call.fd(), buffer as *mut libc::stat) })
19078                }
19079                Syscall::Munmap(call) => {
19080                    let address = call.addr().expect("munmap without an address").as_raw();
19081                    let raw = i64::from(unsafe { libc::munmap(address as *mut _, call.len()) });
19082                    if raw == 0 {
19083                        self.unmapped.push((address, call.len()));
19084                    }
19085                    raw
19086                }
19087                Syscall::Close(call) => {
19088                    self.close_attempts.push(call.fd());
19089                    if let Some(errno) = self.close_errors.pop_front() {
19090                        return Err(errno);
19091                    }
19092                    self.closed.push(call.fd());
19093                    i64::from(unsafe { libc::close(call.fd()) })
19094                }
19095                Syscall::Openat(call) => {
19096                    let path = call.path().expect("openat without a path");
19097                    let path = path.read(&self.memory()).unwrap();
19098                    self.opened_paths
19099                        .push(path.as_os_str().as_encoded_bytes().to_vec());
19100                    if let Some(errno) = self.open_errors.pop_front() {
19101                        return Err(errno);
19102                    }
19103                    let (fd, _) = open_file();
19104                    self.opened_fds.push(fd);
19105                    i64::from(fd)
19106                }
19107                Syscall::Capget(call) => {
19108                    // Every capability, in the effective and permitted sets.
19109                    let data = call.data().expect("capget without data").as_raw();
19110                    let effective = self.capget_effective;
19111                    let words: [u32; 6] = [
19112                        effective as u32,
19113                        u32::MAX,
19114                        0,
19115                        (effective >> 32) as u32,
19116                        0x1ff,
19117                        0,
19118                    ];
19119                    let bytes: Vec<u8> = words.iter().flat_map(|word| word.to_ne_bytes()).collect();
19120                    self.memory()
19121                        .write_exact(AddrMut::<u8>::from_raw(data).unwrap(), &bytes)?;
19122                    0
19123                }
19124                other => panic!("unexpected injected syscall {other:?}"),
19125            };
19126            Errno::result(raw)
19127        }
19128        async fn tail_inject<S: SyscallInfo>(&mut self, _: S) -> reverie::Never {
19129            panic!("fd registration must not retire the guest")
19130        }
19131        fn set_timer(&mut self, _: reverie::TimerSchedule) -> Result<(), Error> {
19132            panic!("fd registration must not set a timer")
19133        }
19134        fn set_timer_precise(&mut self, _: reverie::TimerSchedule) -> Result<(), Error> {
19135            panic!("fd registration must not set a timer")
19136        }
19137        fn read_clock(&mut self) -> Result<u64, Error> {
19138            panic!("fd registration must not read a clock")
19139        }
19140    }
19141
19142    /// Binder's ioctl recorder does not restore nested transaction bytes or
19143    /// installed descriptors. Even valid returned bytes must not add receipt
19144    /// probe events in record/replay. Drive the actual handler; ScriptedGuest
19145    /// rejects an unexpected F_GETFD, so removing the guard fails this test.
19146    #[tokio::test]
19147    async fn binder_record_replay_does_not_add_receipt_probe_events() {
19148        let mut object = [0u8; 24];
19149        object[..4].copy_from_slice(&0x6664_2a85u32.to_ne_bytes()); // BINDER_TYPE_FD
19150        object[8..12].copy_from_slice(&123u32.to_ne_bytes());
19151        let offsets = [0u64];
19152        let mut transaction = [0u8; 64];
19153        transaction[40..48].copy_from_slice(&8u64.to_ne_bytes());
19154        transaction[48..56].copy_from_slice(&(object.as_ptr() as u64).to_ne_bytes());
19155        transaction[56..64].copy_from_slice(&(offsets.as_ptr() as u64).to_ne_bytes());
19156        let mut commands = 0x8040_7202u32.to_ne_bytes().to_vec(); // BR_TRANSACTION
19157        commands.extend_from_slice(&transaction);
19158        for replaying in [false, true] {
19159            let (_, mut guest) = ScriptedGuest::new(true, false);
19160            guest.config.recordreplay_modes = true;
19161            guest.config.replaying = replaying;
19162            guest.config.sequentialize_threads = true;
19163            assert!(!guest.config.backend.tool_shares_guest_descriptor_table);
19164            guest.binder_read_consumed = Some(commands.len() as u64);
19165            let tool = <Detcore as Tool>::new(Pid::from_raw(1), &guest.config);
19166            let mut words = [0, 0, 0, commands.len() as u64, 0, commands.as_ptr() as u64];
19167            let call =
19168                syscalls::Ioctl::new()
19169                    .with_fd(99)
19170                    .with_request(syscalls::ioctl::Request::Other(
19171                        crate::syscalls::binder::BINDER_WRITE_READ as usize,
19172                        words.as_mut_ptr() as usize,
19173                    ));
19174            assert_eq!(tool.handle_ioctl(&mut guest, call).await.unwrap(), 0);
19175            assert_eq!(words[4], commands.len() as u64);
19176            assert_eq!(guest.injected, vec![Sysno::ioctl]);
19177            assert!(guest.thread.with_detfd(123, |_| ()).is_err());
19178            // Positive payload control: this is a real parseable FD result,
19179            // not an empty buffer that would hide an accidentally open gate.
19180            assert_eq!(
19181                crate::syscalls::binder::delivered(&guest.memory(), words.as_ptr() as usize, 0).fds,
19182                vec![123]
19183            );
19184        }
19185    }

19187    mod runtime_readlink_tests {
19188        use std::ffi::CStr;
19189        use std::ffi::CString;
19190        use std::os::fd::AsRawFd;
19191        use std::os::unix::net::UnixStream;
19192
19193        use super::*;
19194
19195        fn local_guest() -> (Detcore, ScriptedGuest) {
19196            let (_, mut guest) = ScriptedGuest::new(true, false);
19197            let pid = std::process::id() as i32;
19198            // SAFETY: gettid has no arguments or memory operands.
19199            let tid = unsafe { libc::syscall(libc::SYS_gettid) } as i32;
19200            guest.backend_ids = Some((Pid::from_raw(pid), Pid::from_raw(tid)));
19201            guest.thread.detpid = Some(DetPid::from_raw(pid));
19202            guest.thread.dettid = DetTid::from_raw(tid);
19203            guest.config.backend = reverie::BackendCapabilities::DBT;
19204            guest.config.virtualize_metadata = false;
19205            let tool = <Detcore as Tool>::new(Pid::from_raw(pid), &guest.config);
19206            (tool, guest)
19207        }
19208
19209        fn record_directory(guest: &ScriptedGuest, fd: RawFd, path: &str) {
19210            guest
19211                .thread
19212                .add_fd(
19213                    fd,
19214                    OFlag::O_RDONLY | OFlag::O_DIRECTORY,
19215                    FdType::Regular,
19216                    None,
19217                )
19218                .unwrap();
19219            guest
19220                .thread
19221                .with_detfd(fd, |detfd| detfd.set_path(path))
19222                .unwrap();
19223        }
19224
19225        async fn read_link(
19226            tool: &Detcore,
19227            guest: &mut ScriptedGuest,
19228            dirfd: Option<RawFd>,
19229            path: Option<&CStr>,
19230            buffer: Option<AddrMut<'_, libc::c_char>>,
19231            size: usize,
19232        ) -> Result<i64, Error> {
19233            let path = path.and_then(|path| PathPtr::from_ptr(path.as_ptr()));
19234            match dirfd {
19235                None => {
19236                    tool.handle_readlink(
19237                        guest,
19238                        syscalls::Readlink::new()
19239                            .with_path(path)
19240                            .with_buf(buffer)
19241                            .with_bufsize(size),
19242                    )
19243                    .await
19244                }
19245                Some(dirfd) => {
19246                    tool.handle_readlinkat(
19247                        guest,
19248                        syscalls::Readlinkat::new()
19249                            .with_dirfd(dirfd)
19250                            .with_path(path)
19251                            .with_buf(buffer)
19252                            .with_buf_len(size),
19253                    )
19254                    .await
19255                }
19256            }
19257        }
19258
19259        fn errno(result: Result<i64, Error>, expected: Errno) {
19260            assert!(
19261                matches!(result, Err(Error::Errno(actual)) if actual == expected),
19262                "{result:?}"
19263            );
19264        }
19265
19266        /// Exercise real cwd-relative lookup without changing the process's
19267        /// cwd while unrelated unit tests may be running.
19268        fn relative_to_cwd(path: &Path) -> String {
19269            let mut relative = PathBuf::new();
19270            for _ in std::env::current_dir().unwrap().components().skip(1) {
19271                relative.push("..");
19272            }
19273            relative.push(path.strip_prefix("/").unwrap());
19274            relative.to_str().unwrap().to_owned()
19275        }
19276
19277        /// A live socket, rather than an absent magic descriptor, supplies
19278        /// the Guest's ownership fact. Exercise the public shared handlers,
19279        /// including their real kernel readlink and protected-fstat boundary.
19280        #[tokio::test]
19281        async fn runtime_fd_links_are_absent_before_any_target_read_or_write() {
19282            let (tool, mut guest) = local_guest();
19283            let (socket, _peer) = UnixStream::pair().unwrap();
19284            let ordinary = std::fs::File::open("/dev/null").unwrap();
19285            let process = std::fs::File::open("/proc/self/fd").unwrap();
19286            let thread = std::fs::File::open("/proc/thread-self/fd").unwrap();
19287            let aliases = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
19288            let alias = aliases.path().join("descriptors");
19289            std::os::unix::fs::symlink("/proc/thread-self/fd", &alias).unwrap();
19290            record_directory(&guest, process.as_raw_fd(), "/proc/self/fd");
19291            record_directory(&guest, thread.as_raw_fd(), "/proc/thread-self/fd");
19292            guest.runtime_fd = Some(socket.as_raw_fd());
19293            assert!(
19294                std::fs::read_link(format!("/proc/thread-self/fd/{}", socket.as_raw_fd()))
19295                    .unwrap()
19296                    .as_os_str()
19297                    .as_bytes()
19298                    .starts_with(b"socket:[")
19299            );
19300
19301            for fd in [socket.as_raw_fd(), ordinary.as_raw_fd()] {
19302                for (dirfd, path) in [
19303                    (None, format!("/proc/self/fd/{fd}")),
19304                    (None, format!("/proc/thread-self/fd/{fd}")),
19305                    (None, format!("/dev/fd/{fd}")),
19306                    (None, format!("/proc/./self/fd/{fd}")),
19307                    (None, format!("/proc/self/../self/fd/{fd}")),
19308                    (
19309                        None,
19310                        relative_to_cwd(Path::new(&format!("/proc/self/fd/{fd}"))),
19311                    ),
19312                    (None, relative_to_cwd(&alias.join(fd.to_string()))),
19313                    (Some(-1), format!("/proc/self/fd/{fd}")),
19314                    (Some(libc::AT_FDCWD), format!("/proc/thread-self/fd/{fd}")),
19315                    (
19316                        Some(libc::AT_FDCWD),
19317                        relative_to_cwd(&alias.join(fd.to_string())),
19318                    ),
19319                    (Some(process.as_raw_fd()), fd.to_string()),
19320                    (Some(thread.as_raw_fd()), fd.to_string()),
19321                    (Some(thread.as_raw_fd()), format!("./{fd}")),
19322                ] {
19323                    let path = CString::new(path).unwrap();
19324                    let mut bytes = [0xa5; 128];
19325                    guest.injected.clear();
19326                    let result = read_link(
19327                        &tool,
19328                        &mut guest,
19329                        dirfd,
19330                        Some(&path),
19331                        AddrMut::from_raw(bytes.as_mut_ptr() as usize),
19332                        bytes.len(),
19333                    )
19334                    .await;
19335                    if fd == socket.as_raw_fd() {
19336                        errno(result, Errno::ENOENT);
19337                        assert_eq!(bytes, [0xa5; 128], "{path:?}");
19338                        assert!(
19339                            !guest.injected.iter().any(|call| matches!(
19340                                call,
19341                                Sysno::readlink | Sysno::readlinkat | Sysno::fstat
19342                            )),
19343                            "{path:?}: {:?}",
19344                            guest.injected
19345                        );
19346                    } else {
19347                        assert_eq!(result.unwrap(), 9, "{path:?}");
19348                        assert_eq!(&bytes[..9], b"/dev/null");
19349                        assert_eq!(&bytes[9..], &[0xa5; 119]);
19350                        assert!(
19351                            guest
19352                                .injected
19353                                .iter()
19354                                .any(|call| matches!(call, Sysno::readlink | Sysno::readlinkat))
19355                        );
19356                    }
19357                }
19358            }
19359            assert_eq!(guest.mapped, guest.unmapped);
19360
19361            // The owner withdraws its fact and the same live slot is reused
19362            // by a guest file. Neither the number nor a past query hides it.
19363            assert_eq!(
19364                unsafe { libc::dup2(ordinary.as_raw_fd(), socket.as_raw_fd()) },
19365                socket.as_raw_fd()
19366            );
19367            guest.runtime_fd = None;
19368            let path = CString::new(format!("/proc/self/fd/{}", socket.as_raw_fd())).unwrap();
19369            let mut bytes = [0xa5; 128];
19370            assert_eq!(
19371                read_link(
19372                    &tool,
19373                    &mut guest,
19374                    None,
19375                    Some(&path),
19376                    AddrMut::from_raw(bytes.as_mut_ptr() as usize),
19377                    bytes.len()
19378                )
19379                .await
19380                .unwrap(),
19381                9
19382            );
19383            assert_eq!(&bytes[..9], b"/dev/null");
19384            assert_eq!(&bytes[9..], &[0xa5; 119]);
19385        }

19387        #[tokio::test]
19388        async fn runtime_fd_parent_translation_preserves_overlapping_output() {
19389            let (tool, mut guest) = local_guest();
19390            let (physical_pid, physical_tid) = guest.backend_ids.unwrap();
19391            // These are this modeled task's guest IDs; the RPC maps them to
19392            // the real process/thread executing every injected lookup. Choose
19393            // two IDs that cannot accidentally equal either physical ID.
19394            let mut modeled_ids = [37, 41, 43, 47]
19395                .into_iter()
19396                .filter(|id| ![physical_pid.as_raw(), physical_tid.as_raw()].contains(id));
19397            let (pid, tid) = (modeled_ids.next().unwrap(), modeled_ids.next().unwrap());
19398            assert_ne!(physical_pid.as_raw(), pid);
19399            assert_ne!(physical_tid.as_raw(), tid);
19400            guest.backend_ids = Some((Pid::from_raw(pid), Pid::from_raw(tid)));
19401            guest.thread.detpid = Some(DetPid::from_raw(pid));
19402            guest.thread.dettid = DetTid::from_raw(tid);
19403            guest.thread.physical_tid = Some(physical_tid.as_raw());
19404            guest.procfs_ids = Some([(pid, physical_pid.as_raw()), (tid, physical_tid.as_raw())]);
19405            let (socket, _peer) = UnixStream::pair().unwrap();
19406            let ordinary = std::fs::File::open("/dev/null").unwrap();
19407            guest.runtime_fd = Some(socket.as_raw_fd());
19408            assert!(Detcore::translates_procfs_numbers(&guest));
19409
19410            // The original output is a legitimate live buffer exactly where
19411            // the synthetic lookup used to stage its translated parent.
19412            // This arena is distinct from ScriptedStack's stat/path scratch.
19413            let mut arena = Box::new([0xa5u8; 4096]);
19414            let start = arena.as_mut_ptr() as usize;
19415            let rsp = start + 2048;
19416            guest.rsp = Some(rsp);
19417            for (parent, physical_parent) in [
19418                (
19419                    format!("/proc/{pid}/fd"),
19420                    format!("/proc/{}/fd", physical_pid.as_raw()),
19421                ),
19422                (
19423                    format!("/proc/{pid}/task/{tid}/fd"),
19424                    format!(
19425                        "/proc/{}/task/{}/fd",
19426                        physical_pid.as_raw(),
19427                        physical_tid.as_raw()
19428                    ),
19429                ),
19430            ] {
19431                // Match stage_in_scratch: 1088 bytes below rsp, NUL included,
19432                // rounded down to 16-byte alignment. Old parent translation
19433                // sees only its own stat/path operands, not this output.
19434                let output = (rsp - 1088 - physical_parent.len() - 1) & !15;
19435                let offset = output.checked_sub(start).unwrap();
19436                assert!(offset + 128 <= arena.len());
19437                for fd in [socket.as_raw_fd(), ordinary.as_raw_fd()] {
19438                    for dirfd in [None, Some(libc::AT_FDCWD)] {
19439                        arena.fill(0xa5);
19440                        guest.injected.clear();
19441                        guest.statat_paths.clear();
19442                        let path = CString::new(format!("{parent}/{fd}")).unwrap();
19443                        let result = read_link(
19444                            &tool,
19445                            &mut guest,
19446                            dirfd,
19447                            Some(&path),
19448                            AddrMut::from_raw(output),
19449                            128,
19450                        )
19451                        .await;
19452                        assert_eq!(
19453                            guest.statat_paths,
19454                            vec![physical_parent.as_bytes().to_vec()]
19455                        );
19456                        let bytes = &arena[offset..offset + 128];
19457                        if fd == socket.as_raw_fd() {
19458                            errno(result, Errno::ENOENT);
19459                            assert_eq!(bytes, &[0xa5; 128]);
19460                            assert!(!guest.injected.iter().any(|call| matches!(
19461                                call,
19462                                Sysno::readlink | Sysno::readlinkat | Sysno::fstat
19463                            )));
19464                        } else {
19465                            assert_eq!(result.unwrap(), 9);
19466                            assert_eq!(&bytes[..9], b"/dev/null");
19467                            assert_eq!(&bytes[9..], &[0xa5; 119]);
19468                        }
19469                    }
19470                }
19471            }
19472            // Translation pages nest inside parent-stat pages, so release
19473            // order is the reverse of allocation order.
19474            guest.mapped.sort_unstable();
19475            guest.unmapped.sort_unstable();
19476            assert_eq!(guest.mapped, guest.unmapped);
19477        }

19552            std::os::unix::fs::symlink("/dev/null", directory.path().join(&name)).unwrap();
19553            let wrong_parent = std::fs::File::open(directory.path()).unwrap();
19554            // A recorded spelling is deliberately stale. Its actual object
19555            // must win; no kernel read of the private socket is involved.

19557            let path = CString::new(name).unwrap();

19564                AddrMut::from_raw(bytes.as_mut_ptr() as usize),
19565                bytes.len(),
19566            )
19567            .await;
19568            // This guard must decline the different object. Do not pin
19569            // the old canonicalizer's errno or any bytes it may leak.
19570            assert!(
19571                !matches!(&result, Err(Error::Errno(error)) if *error == Errno::ENOENT),
19572                "{result:?}"
19573            );

19576
19577            // No proof that this nonleader shares the process's table:
19578            // /proc/self/fd must not borrow its current-thread owner fact.
19579            assert_ne!(guest.thread.dettid, guest.thread.detpid.unwrap());
19580            guest.thread.process_files = None;

19582            let path = CString::new(format!("/proc/self/fd/{}", socket.as_raw_fd())).unwrap();
19583            bytes.fill(0xa5);

19585                &tool,
19586                &mut guest,
19587                None,
19588                Some(&path),
19589                AddrMut::from_raw(bytes.as_mut_ptr() as usize),
19590                bytes.len(),
19591            )
19592            .await;
19593            assert!(
19594                !matches!(&result, Err(Error::Errno(error)) if *error == Errno::ENOENT),
19595                "{result:?}"
19596            );
19597            assert!(guest.injected.contains(&Sysno::readlink));
19598            assert_eq!(guest.mapped, guest.unmapped);

19621                Some(link.as_raw_fd()),

19624                bytes.len(),
19625            )
19626            .await;
19627            // Empty-path O_PATH lookup stays on the original route. Do not
19628            // require the socket identity or a particular result from it.
19629            assert!(guest.injected.contains(&Sysno::readlinkat));

19635                    assert!(bytes[size..].iter().all(|byte| *byte == 0xa5));
19636                }
19637                Err(_) => assert_eq!(bytes, [0xa5; 128]),
19638            }
19639            for suffix in ["/", "/.", "/.."] {
19640                let path =
19641                    CString::new(format!("/proc/self/fd/{}{suffix}", socket.as_raw_fd())).unwrap();
19642                bytes.fill(0xa5);

19644                let _result = read_link(
19645                    &tool,
19646                    &mut guest,
19647                    None,
19648                    Some(&path),
19649                    AddrMut::from_raw(bytes.as_mut_ptr() as usize),
19650                    bytes.len(),
19651                )
19652                .await;

19654                // no-write check without pinning an existence-revealing errno.

19656                assert!(guest.mapped.is_empty());
19657                assert_eq!(bytes, [0xa5; 128]);
19658            }

19663    pub(super) async fn raw_directory_projection() {
19664        use std::os::fd::AsRawFd;
19665        let directory = std::fs::File::open("/proc/self/fd").unwrap();
19666        for format in [DirentFormat::Legacy, DirentFormat::Dirent64] {
19667            let entries = [
19668                DirEntry {
19669                    ino: 91,
19670                    off: 29,
19671                    name: b"40960".to_vec(),
19672                    ty: 8,
19673                },
19674                DirEntry {
19675                    ino: 92,
19676                    off: 17,
19677                    name: b"1024".to_vec(),
19678                    ty: 10,
19679                },
19680                DirEntry {
19681                    ino: 93,
19682                    off: 31,
19683                    name: b"1023".to_vec(),
19684                    ty: 8,
19685                },
19686            ];
19687            let encode = |rows: &[DirEntry]| {
19688                let mut bytes = Vec::new();
19689                for entry in rows {
19690                    format.encode(entry, entry.ino, entry.off, &mut bytes);
19691                }
19692                bytes
19693            };
19694            let mut unmodified = encode(&entries[..1]);
19695            for at in format.name_offset() + entries[0].name.len() + 1..unmodified.len() {
19696                if at != format.type_offset(unmodified.len()) {
19697                    unmodified[at] = 0x7c;
19698                }
19699            }
19700            for (batches, expected, calls) in [
19701                (
19702                    vec![Ok(encode(&entries))],
19703                    Ok(encode(&[entries[0].clone(), entries[2].clone()])),
19704                    1,
19705                ),
19706                (
19707                    vec![Ok(encode(&entries[1..2])), Ok(encode(&entries[..1]))],
19708                    Ok(encode(&entries[..1])),
19709                    2,
19710                ),
19711                (
19712                    vec![Ok(encode(&entries[1..2])), Ok(Vec::new())],
19713                    Ok(Vec::new()),
19714                    2,
19715                ),
19716                (
19717                    vec![Ok(encode(&entries[1..2])), Err(Errno::EIO)],
19718                    Err(Errno::EIO),
19719                    2,
19720                ),
19721                (vec![Ok(unmodified.clone())], Ok(unmodified.clone()), 1),
19722            ] {
19723                let (_, mut guest) = ScriptedGuest::new(true, false);
19724                guest.config.virtualize_metadata = false;
19725                guest.config.backend = reverie::BackendCapabilities::DBT;
19726                guest.runtime_fd = Some(1024);
19727                let written = batches
19728                    .iter()
19729                    .filter_map(|batch| batch.as_ref().ok().map(Vec::len))
19730                    .max()
19731                    .unwrap();
19732                let untouched = expected.as_ref().is_ok_and(|bytes| bytes == &unmodified);
19733                guest.directory_batches = batches.into();
19734                let tool = <Detcore as Tool>::new(Pid::from_raw(1), &guest.config);
19735                let mut bytes = vec![0xa5; 512];
19736                let buffer: AddrMut<u8> = AddrMut::from_raw(bytes.as_mut_ptr() as usize).unwrap();
19737                let result = match format {
19738                    DirentFormat::Legacy => {
19739                        tool.handle_getdents(
19740                            &mut guest,
19741                            syscalls::Getdents::new()
19742                                .with_fd(directory.as_raw_fd() as u32)
19743                                .with_dirent(Some(buffer.cast()))
19744                                .with_count(bytes.len() as u32),
19745                        )
19746                        .await
19747                    }
19748                    DirentFormat::Dirent64 => {
19749                        tool.handle_getdents64(
19750                            &mut guest,
19751                            syscalls::Getdents64::new()
19752                                .with_fd(directory.as_raw_fd() as u32)
19753                                .with_dirent(Some(buffer.cast()))
19754                                .with_count(bytes.len() as u32),
19755                        )
19756                        .await
19757                    }
19758                };
19759                assert_eq!(guest.injected.len(), calls, "{format:?}");
19760                assert!(bytes[written..].iter().all(|byte| *byte == 0xa5));
19761                match expected {
19762                    Ok(expected) => {
19763                        assert_eq!(result.unwrap(), expected.len() as i64, "{format:?}");
19764                        assert_eq!(&bytes[..expected.len()], expected, "{format:?}");
19765                        if !untouched {
19766                            assert!(bytes[expected.len()..written].iter().all(|byte| *byte == 0));
19767                        }
19768                    }
19769                    Err(expected) => {
19770                        assert!(
19771                            matches!(result, Err(Error::Errno(actual)) if actual == expected),
19772                            "{format:?}: {result:?}"
19773                        );
19774                        assert!(bytes[..format.record_len(4)].iter().all(|byte| *byte == 0));
19775                    }
19776                }
19777            }
19778        }
19779    }

19879                regions: vec![reverie::RuntimePrivateMemoryRegion {
19880                    start: 0x1000,
19881                    end: 0x2000,
19882                }],
19883            },
19884        };
19885        guest.private_memory = Some(target.private.clone());
19886        guest.maps_reads = [b"1000-2000 rw-p 00000000 00:00 0 \n".to_vec(), Vec::new()].into();
19887        let fd = 9;
19888        guest
19889            .thread
19890            .add_fd(fd, OFlag::O_RDONLY, FdType::Regular, None)
19891            .unwrap();
19892        let mut file = ProcfsFile::from_path(Path::new("/proc/2/maps")).unwrap();
19893        file.bind_maps_target(target.clone());
19894        guest
19895            .thread
19896            .with_detfd(fd, |detfd| detfd.set_procfs(file.clone()))
19897            .unwrap();
19898        let mut output = [0xa5_u8; 512];
19899        let call = syscalls::Read::new()
19900            .with_fd(fd)
19901            .with_buf(AddrMut::from_raw(output.as_mut_ptr() as usize))
19902            .with_len(output.len());
19903
19904        let error = tool
19905            .initialize_procfs_snapshot(&mut guest, call)
19906            .await
19907            .unwrap_err();
19908        assert!(
19909            matches!(error, Error::Tool(ref error) if error.to_string() ==
19910            "runtime-private maps view unavailable: target ownership changed during capture"),
19911            "{error:?}"
19912        );
19913        assert_eq!(guest.private_validations.load(Ordering::SeqCst), 2);
19914        assert!(guest.maps_reads.is_empty());
19915        assert_eq!(guest.injected, [Sysno::lseek, Sysno::read, Sysno::read]);
19916        assert_eq!(output, [0xa5; 512]);
19917        guest
19918            .thread
19919            .with_detfd(fd, |detfd| {
19920                assert!(detfd.procfs_needs_snapshot());
19921                assert_eq!(detfd.procfs_position(), Some((0, None)));
19922                assert_eq!(detfd.preview_procfs(512), None);
19923                assert_eq!(detfd.procfs_maps_target(), Some(target.clone()));
19924            })
19925            .unwrap();
19926        assert_eq!(guest.take_scratch_page(), vec![0xa5; 4096]);
19927    }

19929    /// A real descriptor the test owns by number, and its inode. Ownership is
19930    /// raw so a descriptor that Detcore closes is never closed a second time.
19931    fn open_file() -> (RawFd, u64) {
19932        let file = tempfile::tempfile().unwrap();
19933        let inode = file.metadata().unwrap().ino();
19934        (file.into_raw_fd(), inode)
19935    }
19936
19937    fn close_unless_detcore_did(guest: &ScriptedGuest, fd: RawFd) {
19938        if !guest.closed.contains(&fd) {
19939            assert_eq!(unsafe { libc::close(fd) }, 0);
19940        }
19941    }
19942
19943    fn recorded_inode(guest: &ScriptedGuest, fd: RawFd) -> Option<u64> {
19944        guest
19945            .thread
19946            .with_detfd(fd, |detfd| detfd.stat().map(|stat| stat.inode))
19947            .unwrap()
19948    }

19950    /// The errno of a call the failure policy answered, which a guest run
19951    /// with --allow-unsupported-syscalls sees.
19952    fn policy_errno(error: Error) -> Errno {
19953        error.into_errno().unwrap()
19954    }
19955
19956    /// The task whose `/proc/3/auxv` the access tests open.
19957    const TARGET: crate::procfs::BoundTask = crate::procfs::BoundTask {
19958        process: 3,
19959        thread: None,
19960    };
19961
19962    /// Another process's open of a rendered `/proc/<pid>/auxv`, decided
19963    /// through `ptrace_read_allowed` by the caller's probe opens, as the
19964    /// kernel beneath answers them:
19965    /// - the target's probe opens: allowed, one probe;
19966    /// - it is refused while the caller's `/proc/thread-self/stat` opens: the
19967    ///   refusal's errno;
19968    /// - both are refused with EACCES (the provider's backstop): the caller's
19969    ///   CAP_SYS_PTRACE decides, with and without it;
19970    /// - both fail with EMFILE (a full descriptor table): EMFILE, never the
19971    ///   fallback's EACCES;
19972    /// - an open Reverie reports did not run (ERESTARTSYS) is retried.
19973    #[tokio::test]
19974    async fn the_auxv_access_check_follows_the_kernel_beneaths_answers() {
19975        let paths = |guest: &ScriptedGuest| guest.opened_paths.clone();
19976        let target = b"/proc/3/auxv".to_vec();
19977        let serves = b"/proc/thread-self/stat".to_vec();
19978        let all = (1_u64 << 41) - 1;
19979        let without_ptrace = all & !(1 << 19);
19980        for (errors, effective, answer, probes, capget) in [
19981            (vec![], all, Ok(()), vec![target.clone()], false),
19982            (
19983                vec![Errno::EACCES],
19984                all,
19985                Err(Errno::EACCES),
19986                vec![target.clone(), serves.clone()],
19987                false,
19988            ),
19989            (
19990                vec![Errno::EACCES, Errno::EACCES],
19991                all,
19992                Ok(()),
19993                vec![target.clone(), serves.clone()],
19994                true,
19995            ),
19996            (
19997                vec![Errno::EACCES, Errno::EACCES],
19998                without_ptrace,
19999                Err(Errno::EACCES),
20000                vec![target.clone(), serves.clone()],
20001                true,
20002            ),
20003            (
20004                vec![Errno::EMFILE, Errno::EMFILE],
20005                without_ptrace,
20006                Err(Errno::EMFILE),
20007                vec![target.clone(), serves.clone()],
20008                false,
20009            ),
20010            (
20011                vec![Errno::ERESTARTSYS],
20012                without_ptrace,
20013                Ok(()),
20014                vec![target.clone(), target.clone()],
20015                false,
20016            ),
20017        ] {
20018            let (_tool, mut guest) = ScriptedGuest::with_scratch_page(true);
20019            guest.open_errors.extend(errors.clone());
20020            guest.capget_effective = effective;
20021            let result = Detcore::ptrace_read_allowed(&mut guest, TARGET).await;
20022            assert_eq!(result.unwrap(), answer, "{errors:?}");
20023            assert_eq!(paths(&guest), probes, "{errors:?}");
20024            assert_eq!(
20025                guest.injected.contains(&Sysno::capget),
20026                capget,
20027                "{errors:?}"
20028            );
20029            assert_eq!(guest.closed, guest.opened_fds, "every probe is closed");
20030            assert!(
20031                guest.take_scratch_page().iter().all(|byte| *byte == 0xa5),
20032                "{errors:?}: the scratch is left modified"
20033            );
20034        }
20035    }
20036
20037    /// Guest stack scratch that cannot be used, or cannot be put back, is
20038    /// the failure policy's (EOPNOTSUPP under --allow-unsupported-syscalls,
20039    /// a named stop otherwise), never an access answer:
20040    /// - a commit that fails, its partial write put back: no probe runs,
20041    ///   and the scratch is as it was;
20042    /// - a commit that fails part way and whose partial write cannot be put
20043    ///   back;
20044    /// - a probe, and a capget (K1's), whose scratch becomes read-only
20045    ///   before it is put back.
20046    /// And a capget that succeeds puts its scratch back.
20047    #[tokio::test]
20048    async fn guest_stack_scratch_failures_go_to_the_failure_policy() {
20049        // A commit that fails, put back.
20050        let (_tool, mut guest) = ScriptedGuest::with_scratch_page(false);
20051        guest.commit_partial = true;
20052        let result = Detcore::ptrace_read_allowed(&mut guest, TARGET).await;
20053        assert_eq!(policy_errno(result.unwrap_err()), Errno::EOPNOTSUPP);
20054        assert!(guest.injected.is_empty());
20055        assert!(guest.take_scratch_page().iter().all(|byte| *byte == 0xa5));
20056        // A partial write that cannot be put back.
20057        let (_tool, mut guest) = ScriptedGuest::with_scratch_page(false);
20058        guest.commit_partial = true;
20059        guest.protect_page_on_commit_failure = true;
20060        let result = Detcore::ptrace_read_allowed(&mut guest, TARGET).await;
20061        assert_eq!(policy_errno(result.unwrap_err()), Errno::EOPNOTSUPP);
20062        assert!(guest.injected.is_empty());
20063        guest.take_scratch_page();
20064        let (_tool, mut guest) = ScriptedGuest::with_scratch_page(false);
20065        guest.commit_partial = true;
20066        guest.protect_page_on_commit_failure = true;
20067        let result =
20068            Detcore::inject_capget(&mut guest, rendered_procfs::CapabilitySet::Effective).await;
20069        assert_eq!(policy_errno(result.unwrap_err()), Errno::EOPNOTSUPP);
20070        guest.take_scratch_page();
20071        // A probe whose scratch cannot be put back: its descriptor is still
20072        // closed.
20073        let (_tool, mut guest) = ScriptedGuest::with_scratch_page(true);
20074        guest.protect_page_on = Some(Sysno::openat);
20075        let result = Detcore::ptrace_read_allowed(&mut guest, TARGET).await;
20076        assert_eq!(policy_errno(result.unwrap_err()), Errno::EOPNOTSUPP);
20077        assert_eq!(guest.closed, guest.opened_fds);
20078        guest.take_scratch_page();
20079        // A capget whose scratch cannot be put back.
20080        let (_tool, mut guest) = ScriptedGuest::with_scratch_page(true);
20081        guest.protect_page_on = Some(Sysno::capget);
20082        let result =
20083            Detcore::inject_capget(&mut guest, rendered_procfs::CapabilitySet::Effective).await;
20084        assert_eq!(policy_errno(result.unwrap_err()), Errno::EOPNOTSUPP);
20085        guest.take_scratch_page();
20086        // A capget that succeeds.
20087        let (_tool, mut guest) = ScriptedGuest::with_scratch_page(true);
20088        let result =
20089            Detcore::inject_capget(&mut guest, rendered_procfs::CapabilitySet::Effective).await;
20090        assert_eq!(result.unwrap(), Some((1 << 41) - 1));
20091        assert!(guest.take_scratch_page().iter().all(|byte| *byte == 0xa5));
20092    }
20093
20094    /// The probe's close, as Linux's close allows: a close Reverie reports
20095    /// did not run (ERESTARTSYS) is retried; EINTR is not (Linux released
20096    /// the descriptor before returning it); any other error is the failure
20097    /// policy's, never a silent leak.
20098    #[tokio::test]
20099    async fn the_auxv_access_probe_closes_its_descriptor_as_linux_close_allows() {
20100        let (_tool, mut guest) = ScriptedGuest::with_scratch_page(true);
20101        guest.close_errors.push_back(Errno::ERESTARTSYS);
20102        let result = Detcore::ptrace_read_allowed(&mut guest, TARGET).await;
20103        assert_eq!(result.unwrap(), Ok(()));
20104        let [fd] = guest.opened_fds[..] else { panic!() };
20105        assert_eq!(
20106            guest.close_attempts,
20107            [fd, fd],
20108            "a close that did not run is retried"
20109        );
20110        assert_eq!(guest.closed, [fd]);
20111        guest.take_scratch_page();
20112        for (errno, failed) in [(Errno::EINTR, false), (Errno::EBADF, true)] {
20113            let (_tool, mut guest) = ScriptedGuest::with_scratch_page(true);
20114            guest.close_errors.push_back(errno);
20115            let result = Detcore::ptrace_read_allowed(&mut guest, TARGET).await;
20116            let [fd] = guest.opened_fds[..] else { panic!() };
20117            assert_eq!(guest.close_attempts, [fd], "{errno} is not retried");
20118            match result {
20119                Ok(answer) => {
20120                    assert!(!failed, "{errno}");
20121                    assert_eq!(answer, Ok(()));
20122                }
20123                Err(error) => {
20124                    assert!(failed, "{errno}");
20125                    assert_eq!(policy_errno(error), Errno::EOPNOTSUPP);
20126                }
20127            }
20128            // The scripted error left the real descriptor open.
20129            assert_eq!(unsafe { libc::close(fd) }, 0);
20130            assert!(guest.take_scratch_page().iter().all(|byte| *byte == 0xa5));
20131        }
20132    }

20134    /// Exercise the actual shared helper with nonzero borrowed bytes and
20135    /// real kernel fstat success/error. The selectable zero commit matches
20136    /// reverie-ptrace GuestStack::commit, rather than duplicating Detcore's
20137    /// restoration algorithm in a standalone test helper.
20138    #[tokio::test]
20139    async fn injected_fstat_restores_nonzero_borrowed_bytes_on_success_and_error() {
20140        for success in [true, false] {
20141            let (_, mut guest) = ScriptedGuest::new(true, false);
20142            guest.zero_on_commit = true;
20143            for (index, word) in guest.arena.iter_mut().enumerate() {
20144                *word = 0xa5a5_a5a5_a5a5_a5a5 ^ index as u64;
20145            }
20146            let original = *guest.arena;
20147            let (fd, inode) = if success { open_file() } else { (-1, 0) };
20148            let copied = Detcore::inject_stat_on_stack(
20149                &mut guest,
20150                |statptr| {
20151                    Syscall::Fstat(syscalls::Fstat::new().with_fd(fd).with_stat(Some(statptr)))
20152                },
20153                None,
20154            )
20155            .await;
20156            if success {
20157                assert_eq!(unsafe { libc::close(fd) }, 0);
20158                assert_eq!(copied.unwrap().st_ino, inode);
20159            } else {
20160                assert_eq!(copied.err(), Some(StatFailure::Call(Errno::EBADF)));
20161            }
20162            assert_eq!(
20163                *guest.arena, original,
20164                "success={success}: all borrowed and neighboring bytes"
20165            );
20166            assert_eq!(guest.injected, [Sysno::fstat]);
20167            assert_eq!(guest.fstat_guard_live, [true]);
20168            assert!(!guest.guard_live.load(Ordering::SeqCst));
20169            assert!(guest.mapped.is_empty());
20170        }
20171    }

20401            guest.close_errors = errors.clone().into();
20402            let closed = tool.close_unclassified(&mut guest, fd).await;
20403            close_unless_detcore_did(&guest, fd);
20404            assert!(
20405                matches!(closed, Err(Error::Tool(_))),
20406                "{errors:?}: {closed:?}"
20407            );
20408            assert_eq!(
20409                guest.thread.with_detfd(fd, |_| ()),
20410                Ok(()),
20411                "{errors:?}: a descriptor still open stays modeled"
20412            );
20413        }
20414    }
20415
20416    /// The canonical statfs view: fixed caps on the free counts, clamped to
20417    /// the mount's totals, and a zero `f_fsid`, with the totals kept. These
20418    /// fabricated-input cases moved here from the KVM executor's copy of
20419    /// this canonicalization, deleted in favour of this one.
20420    #[test]
20421    fn canonicalize_statfs_buf_caps_free_counts_and_zeroes_the_fsid() {
20422        let (tool, mut guest) = ScriptedGuest::new(false, false);
20423        let mut canonical = |mut statfs: libc::statfs| {
20424            let buffer = AddrMut::from_raw(std::ptr::from_mut(&mut statfs) as usize);
20425            tool.canonicalize_statfs_buf(&mut guest, buffer).unwrap();
20426            statfs
20427        };
20428        // SAFETY: fsid_t is two initialized integer words on x86-64.
20429        let fsid = |statfs: &libc::statfs| unsafe {
20430            std::mem::transmute::<libc::fsid_t, [i32; 2]>(statfs.f_fsid)
20431        };
20432        // SAFETY: zero is a valid statfs.
20433        let zero = unsafe { std::mem::zeroed::<libc::statfs>() };
20434
20435        // Totals above both caps: the free counts take the caps.
20436        let mut large = zero;
20437        large.f_blocks = 10_000_000;
20438        large.f_bfree = 7_123_456;
20439        large.f_bavail = 6_987_654;
20440        large.f_files = 2_000_000;
20441        large.f_ffree = 1_234_567;
20442        // SAFETY: fsid_t is two integer words on x86-64.
20443        large.f_fsid = unsafe { std::mem::transmute::<[i32; 2], libc::fsid_t>([0x1234, 0x5678]) };
20444        let large = canonical(large);
20445        assert_eq!(
20446            (large.f_bfree, large.f_bavail, large.f_ffree),
20447            (1_000_000, 1_000_000, 500_000)
20448        );
20449        assert_eq!(fsid(&large), [0, 0]);
20450        assert_eq!((large.f_blocks, large.f_files), (10_000_000, 2_000_000));
20451
20452        // Totals under the caps: the free counts are the totals, never more.
20453        let mut small = zero;
20454        small.f_blocks = 42;
20455        small.f_bfree = 40;
20456        small.f_files = 300;
20457        small.f_ffree = 7;
20458        let small = canonical(small);
20459        assert_eq!(
20460            (small.f_bfree, small.f_bavail, small.f_ffree),
20461            (42, 42, 300)
20462        );
20463        assert_eq!((small.f_blocks, small.f_files), (42, 300));
20464
20465        // A filesystem that keeps no inode count reports no free inodes, and
20466        // its free blocks are still clamped to its total.
20467        let mut no_inodes = zero;
20468        no_inodes.f_blocks = 42;
20469        no_inodes.f_ffree = 9;
20470        let no_inodes = canonical(no_inodes);
20471        assert_eq!((no_inodes.f_files, no_inodes.f_ffree), (0, 0));
20472        assert_eq!((no_inodes.f_bfree, no_inodes.f_bavail), (42, 42));
20473
20474        // A null buffer is left alone.
20475        tool.canonicalize_statfs_buf(&mut guest, None).unwrap();
20476    }
20477}

20485    /// A namespace change's operand is reported as the path it names, made
20486    /// absolute. One that could not be read (a tracer may not read a
20487    /// non-dumpable guest's memory) or made absolute is reported as `/`, the
20488    /// ancestor of every path, so that no host input change is named in that

20519    const PAGE: (u64, u64) = (0x7100_0000, 0x7100_1000);
20520
20521    fn args(arg0: u64, arg1: u64, arg2: u64, arg3: u64, arg4: u64) -> SyscallArgs {
20522        SyscallArgs::new(
20523            arg0 as usize,

20532    /// A thread cloned without CLONE_FILES has its own descriptor table, so
20533    /// a descriptor is read through the thread that opened it. Through its
20534    /// leader the same number names nothing here, which would make an
20535    /// ordinary write-mode open count as unreadable (a false `/` that
20536    /// withholds a real host input change) and would miss the thread's own
20537    /// process-memory file.
20538    #[test]
20539    fn a_descriptor_is_read_through_the_thread_that_opened_it() {
20540        use std::os::fd::AsRawFd;
20541
20542        let directory = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
20543        let ordinary = directory.path().join("out");
20544        let named_mem = directory.path().join("mem");
20545        std::thread::spawn(move || {
20546            // SAFETY: gives only this thread a private copy of the table.
20547            assert_eq!(unsafe { libc::unshare(libc::CLONE_FILES) }, 0);
20548            // SAFETY: plain syscalls on this thread's own descriptors.
20549            let tid = unsafe { libc::gettid() };
20550            let leader = std::process::id() as i32;
20551            let files = [
20552                (std::fs::File::create(&ordinary).unwrap(), false),
20553                (std::fs::File::create(&named_mem).unwrap(), false),
20554                (
20555                    std::fs::OpenOptions::new()
20556                        .read(true)
20557                        .write(true)
20558                        .open("/proc/thread-self/mem")
20559                        .unwrap(),
20560                    true,
20561                ),
20562            ];
20563            for (number, (file, is_process_memory)) in (900..).zip(files) {
20564                assert_eq!(unsafe { libc::dup2(file.as_raw_fd(), number) }, number);
20565                drop(file);
20566                let identity = descriptor_identity(tid, number);
20567                assert!(identity.is_some(), "{number}");
20568                assert_eq!(descriptor_identity(leader, number), None, "{number}");
20569                assert_eq!(
20570                    may_write_process_memory(
20571                        OFlag::O_WRONLY,
20572                        identity
20573                            .as_ref()
20574                            .map(|(link, procfs)| (link.as_path(), *procfs)),
20575                    ),
20576                    is_process_memory,
20577                    "{identity:?}"
20578                );
20579                assert_eq!(unsafe { libc::close(number) }, 0);
20580            }
20581        })
20582        .join()
20583        .unwrap();
20584    }
