20586    /// Every call that can replace, unprotect, discard or unmap the range
20587    /// counts when its interval reaches any byte of it, and not when it stops
20588    /// short of it or starts after it.
20589    #[test]
20590    fn a_call_counts_exactly_when_it_may_change_the_range() {
20591        let fixed = libc::MAP_FIXED as u64 | libc::MAP_PRIVATE as u64;
20592        let huge = fixed | libc::MAP_HUGETLB as u64;
20593        let huge_1gb = (30 << libc::MAP_HUGE_SHIFT) as u64;
20594        let remap_fixed = (libc::MREMAP_MAYMOVE | libc::MREMAP_FIXED) as u64;
20595        let remap = libc::SHM_REMAP as u64;
20596        let cases = [
20597            (
20598                "mmap fixed over it",
20599                Sysno::mmap,
20600                args(0x7100_0000, 0x1000, 7, fixed, 0),
20601                true,
20602            ),
20603            (
20604                "mmap fixed reaching it",
20605                Sysno::mmap,
20606                args(0x70ff_f000, 0x1001, 7, fixed, 0),
20607                true,
20608            ),
20609            (
20610                "mmap fixed below it",
20611                Sysno::mmap,
20612                args(0x70ff_f000, 0x1000, 7, fixed, 0),
20613                false,
20614            ),
20615            (
20616                "mmap fixed above it",
20617                Sysno::mmap,
20618                args(0x7100_1000, 0x1000, 7, fixed, 0),
20619                false,
20620            ),
20621            (
20622                "mmap hinted at it",
20623                Sysno::mmap,
20624                args(0x7100_0000, 0x1000, 7, 0x22, 0),
20625                false,
20626            ),
20627            // The host default here is 2 MiB; 0x7100_0000 is 2 MiB aligned.
20628            (
20629                "mmap fixed default huge page holding it",
20630                Sysno::mmap,
20631                args(0x7110_0000, 1, 7, huge, 0),
20632                true,
20633            ),
20634            (
20635                "mmap fixed small page there",
20636                Sysno::mmap,
20637                args(0x7110_0000, 1, 7, fixed, 0),
20638                false,
20639            ),
20640            (
20641                "mmap fixed default huge page below it",
20642                Sysno::mmap,
20643                args(0x70ff_f000, 1, 7, huge, 0),
20644                false,
20645            ),
20646            (
20647                "mmap fixed 1 GiB page holding it",
20648                Sysno::mmap,
20649                args(0x4000_0000, 1, 7, huge | huge_1gb, 0),
20650                true,
20651            ),
20652            (
20653                "mmap fixed 1 GiB page elsewhere",
20654                Sysno::mmap,
20655                args(0x8000_0000, 1, 7, huge | huge_1gb, 0),
20656                false,
20657            ),
20658            (
20659                "mprotect of it",
20660                Sysno::mprotect,
20661                args(0x7100_0000, 0x1000, 7, 0, 0),
20662                true,
20663            ),
20664            (
20665                "mprotect covering it",
20666                Sysno::mprotect,
20667                args(0x7000_0000, 0x200_0000, 7, 0, 0),
20668                true,
20669            ),
20670            (
20671                "mprotect of a zero length",
20672                Sysno::mprotect,
20673                args(0x7100_0000, 0, 7, 0, 0),
20674                true,
20675            ),
20676            (
20677                "pkey_mprotect of it",
20678                Sysno::pkey_mprotect,
20679                args(0x7100_0000, 1, 7, 0, 0),
20680                true,
20681            ),
20682            (
20683                "madvise of it",
20684                Sysno::madvise,
20685                args(0x7100_0000, 0x1000, 4, 0, 0),
20686                true,
20687            ),
20688            (
20689                "munmap of it",
20690                Sysno::munmap,
20691                args(0x7100_0000, 0x1000, 0, 0, 0),
20692                true,
20693            ),
20694            (
20695                "munmap past it",
20696                Sysno::munmap,
20697                args(0x7100_1000, 0x1000, 0, 0, 0),
20698                false,
20699            ),
20700            (
20701                "mremap from it",
20702                Sysno::mremap,
20703                args(0x7100_0000, 0x1000, 0x2000, 1, 0),
20704                true,
20705            ),
20706            (
20707                "mremap fixed onto it",
20708                Sysno::mremap,
20709                args(0x6000_0000, 0x1000, 0x1000, remap_fixed, 0x7100_0000),
20710                true,
20711            ),
20712            (
20713                "mremap fixed of a small page into its gigabyte",
20714                Sysno::mremap,
20715                args(0x6000_0000, 0x1000, 0x1000, remap_fixed, 0x4000_0000),
20716                false,
20717            ),
20718            (
20719                "mremap moving elsewhere",
20720                Sysno::mremap,
20721                args(0x6000_0000, 0x1000, 0x2000, 1, 0x7100_0000),
20722                false,
20723            ),
20724            (
20725                "shmat remapping at it",
20726                Sysno::shmat,
20727                args(3, 0x7100_0000, remap, 0, 0),
20728                true,
20729            ),
20730            (
20731                "shmat remapping below it",
20732                Sysno::shmat,
20733                args(3, 0x6000_0000, remap, 0, 0),
20734                true,
20735            ),
20736            (
20737                "shmat without remap",
20738                Sysno::shmat,
20739                args(3, 0x7100_0000, 0, 0, 0),
20740                false,
20741            ),
20742            (
20743                "shmat anywhere",
20744                Sysno::shmat,
20745                args(3, 0, remap, 0, 0),
20746                false,
20747            ),
20748            ("brk", Sysno::brk, args(0x7100_0000, 0, 0, 0, 0), false),
20749            // A scalar argument that equals an address in the range is not one.
20750            (
20751                "lseek to that offset",
20752                Sysno::lseek,
20753                args(3, 0x7100_0000, 0, 0, 0),
20754                false,
20755            ),
20756            (
20757                "an address near the end",
20758                Sysno::munmap,
20759                args(u64::MAX - 0xfff, 0x1000, 0, 0, 0),
20760                false,
20761            ),
20762        ];
20763        for (label, number, args, expected) in cases {
20764            assert_eq!(
20765                may_change_untraced_code(number, &args, PAGE, 2 << 20),
20766                expected,
20767                "{label}"
20768            );
20769        }
20770    }

20772    /// `pidfd_send_signal`'s flags select one scope, as Linux's do; an unknown
20773    /// bit or two scopes are EINVAL (https://github.com/rrnewton/hermit/issues/4108).
20774    #[test]
20775    fn pidfd_signal_flags_select_one_scope() {
20776        assert_eq!(pidfd_signal_scope(0), Ok(PidfdSignalScope::Process));
20777        assert_eq!(pidfd_signal_scope(1), Ok(PidfdSignalScope::Thread));
20778        assert_eq!(pidfd_signal_scope(2), Ok(PidfdSignalScope::Process));
20779        assert_eq!(pidfd_signal_scope(4), Ok(PidfdSignalScope::ProcessGroup));
20780        for flags in [3, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 1 << 31, u32::MAX] {
20781            assert_eq!(pidfd_signal_scope(flags), Err(Errno::EINVAL), "{flags:#x}");
20782        }
20783    }

20785    /// A descriptor names a process for `pidfd_send_signal` only when it is a
20786    /// directory whose parent is the root of the guest's procfs and whose name
20787    /// is a pid; another file is EBADF, and a pidfd Detcore did not open, an
20788    /// unreadable descriptor or another procfs instance cannot be classified.
20789    #[test]
20790    fn a_proc_process_directory_names_its_process() {
20791        use ProcessDirectoryDescriptor as D;
20792        let procfs = |link: &str, parent: Option<(u64, u64)>| DescriptorFacts {
20793            link: PathBuf::from(link),
20794            on_procfs: true,
20795            is_dir: parent.is_some(),
20796            dev: 22,
20797            parent,
20798            guest_proc_dev: Some(22),
20799        };
20800        let reaped = |link: &str| DescriptorFacts {
20801            is_dir: true,
20802            ..procfs(link, None)
20803        };
20804        let root = Some((22, PROC_ROOT_INO));
20805        let cases = [
20806            (
20807                "process",
20808                procfs("/proc/3", root),
20809                D::Process(DetPid::from_raw(3)),
20810            ),
20811            (
20812                "reaped process",
20813                reaped("/proc/7 (deleted)"),
20814                D::Process(DetPid::from_raw(7)),
20815            ),
20816            (
20817                "reaped task directory",
20818                reaped("/proc/7/task/8 (deleted)"),
20819                D::NotAProcess,
20820            ),
20821            (
20822                "reaped elsewhere",
20823                reaped("/mnt/p/7 (deleted)"),
20824                D::Unknown("it names a reaped task outside the guest's /proc"),
20825            ),
20826            (
20827                "procfs mounted elsewhere",
20828                procfs("/mnt/p/3", root),
20829                D::Process(DetPid::from_raw(3)),
20830            ),
20831            (
20832                "task directory",
20833                procfs("/proc/3/task/3", Some((22, 4000))),
20834                D::NotAProcess,
20835            ),
20836            (
20837                "procfs file",
20838                procfs("/proc/3/status", None),
20839                D::NotAProcess,
20840            ),
20841            (
20842                "named root entry",
20843                procfs("/proc/sys", root),
20844                D::NotAProcess,
20845            ),
20846            ("pid zero", procfs("/proc/0", root), D::NotAProcess),
20847            ("leading zero", procfs("/proc/03", root), D::NotAProcess),
20848            ("signed", procfs("/proc/+3", root), D::NotAProcess),
20849            (
20850                "another procfs root",
20851                procfs("/proc/3", Some((23, PROC_ROOT_INO))),
20852                D::NotAProcess,
20853            ),
20854            (
20855                "not the guest's procfs",
20856                DescriptorFacts {
20857                    guest_proc_dev: Some(99),
20858                    ..procfs("/proc/3", root)
20859                },
20860                D::Unknown("it is a procfs that is not the guest's /proc"),
20861            ),
20862            (
20863                "ordinary directory",
20864                DescriptorFacts {
20865                    on_procfs: false,
20866                    ..procfs("/tmp/3", root)
20867                },
20868                D::NotAProcess,
20869            ),
20870            (
20871                "pidfd",
20872                DescriptorFacts {
20873                    on_procfs: false,
20874                    ..procfs("anon_inode:[pidfd]", None)
20875                },
20876                D::Unknown("it is a pidfd that Detcore did not open with pidfd_open"),
20877            ),
20878            (
20879                "pidfs pidfd",
20880                DescriptorFacts {
20881                    on_procfs: false,
20882                    ..procfs("pidfd:[1234]", None)
20883                },
20884                D::Unknown("it is a pidfd that Detcore did not open with pidfd_open"),
20885            ),
20886        ];
20887        for (label, facts, expected) in cases {
20888            assert_eq!(
20889                classify_process_directory(Some(&facts)),
20890                expected,
20891                "{label}"
20892            );
20893        }
20894        assert_eq!(
20895            classify_process_directory(None),
20896            D::Unknown("Hermit cannot read what the descriptor names")
20897        );
20898    }

20900    /// A write-mode open counts when its descriptor is a procfs file named
20901    /// `mem`, or cannot be read at all; a read-only or `O_PATH` open, an
20902    /// ordinary file named `mem`, a pipe, and another procfs file do not.

20915            ("process mem read-only", OFlag::O_RDONLY, proc_mem, false),

20923                "an ordinary file named mem",

20929                "a name that leads to a pipe",

20933            ),
20934            (
20935                "another procfs file",

20937                Some((Path::new("/proc/12/attr/current"), true)),
20938                false,
20939            ),
20940            (
20941                "an unreadable read-only descriptor",

20957/// Closing advice of every flock refusal. It names no backend: LOCK_NB is the
20958/// form Detcore can serve wherever the backend supports flock, and ENOLCK
20959/// reaches the guest only when the run opted in to unsupported syscalls.
20960const FLOCK_REFUSAL_ADVICE: &str = "LOCK_NB is the supported form where the backend \
20961     supports flock at all; ENOLCK is returned instead only under \
20962     --allow-unsupported-syscalls.";
20963
20964/// Report a flock refusal in every disposition, fail-closed (the run ends)
20965/// and opted in (the guest gets ENOLCK): through tracing, and directly on
20966/// stderr so that neither --log=off nor --log-file hides the reason.
20967fn report_flock_refusal(message: &str) {
20968    error!("{message}");
20969    let _ = std::io::Write::write_fmt(
20970        &mut crate::util::RetryingStderr,
20971        format_args!("hermit: {message}\n"),
20972    );
20973}

20980    fn statx_sync_modes_keep_linux_positive_and_negative_contract() {

20988        // Preserve the existing descriptor/no-path rule for other flag bits.
